node.docstring: MCPZ main entrypoint (Fabric "main"). Runs on both client and dedicatedserver. Boots config, logging, modules and the save integration. Neverreferences client-only classes (architecture boundary, tested).

node.name: McpzClient
node.docstring: MCPZ client entrypoint. Boots the live camera, input, raycast, reveal, HUDand domain adapter; suppresses the vanilla survival HUD; registers the MCPZkeybindings. Client-only — never loaded on the dedicated server.

node.name: McpzClientReceivers
node.docstring: Fabric transport adapter for the canonical client payload dispatcher. Fabricowns registration, thread marshalling, and disconnect events; state mutationand resync policy live in {@link ClientPayloadDispatcher}.

node.name: McpzAtmosphereController
node.docstring:
Exterior fog / brightness (IsoCraft parity feature): a moody atmospheric fog for the isometric exterior, applied by {@code FogRendererMixin} only while the MCPZ camera is active. Purely presentation — it never touches gameplay state.

The fog color doubles as the exterior brightness control (a higher brightness lifts the fog/sky tone toward white). All parameters clamp through pure static helpers so the tunables are unit-testable without a renderer.

node.name: clampBrightness
node.docstring: Brightness (exposure multiplier) clamped to a sane range.

node.name: configure
node.signature: void (float r, float g, float b, float fogStart, float fogEnd, float brightness)

node.name: clampFog
node.docstring: Fog distances: start >= 1 and end strictly greater than start.

node.name: apply
node.docstring: Applies the configured fog to the frame's {@link FogData}. No-op when disabled.

node.name: fogColor
node.docstring: Fog color scaled by brightness, each channel clamped to [0, 1].
node.signature: float[] (float r, float g, float b, float brightness)

questions.question: Where is the MinecraftItemRepresentationRegistry class defined?

expected.details: Class adapting Project Zomboid item concepts to vanilla Minecraft item registries.

node.name: MinecraftItemRepresentationRegistry
node.docstring:
Maps stable MCPZ item definition IDs (data/content/items/tier-a.json) to their Minecraft representations (W3-ITEMS). Minecraft registered items are adapters for MCPZ domain items — ItemStack is never the gameplay truth. The table below mirrors tier-a.json deterministically; {@code ItemTableConsistencyTest} verifies it against the JSON so the two cannot drift silently.

Missing mappings throw a readable development error; there is no silent fallback to an unrelated vanilla item. {@link #registerMinecraftItems()} is common/server-safe (no client classes) and runs from the mod initializer.
